node.statement: Factor branch: in the ambient finite-dimensional raw-factor setup, let A=Im(tilde-Phi), let v:B->A be the extended isomorphism furnished below, and define tilde-Delta=v (with codomain included in B(H)); then for every n and X, (1-C_V*eta)||X|| <= ||tilde-Delta_n X|| <= (1+C_V*eta)||X||, hence ||tilde-Delta||_cb <= 1+C_V*eta.
